subject: general
question: After the Mars Mission, which inter-planetary mission is India eyeing at?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Venus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• After the successful **Mars Orbiter Mission,** ISRO is eyeing inter-planetary missions to **Jupiter and Venus** and is studying them practically.
 
• The project announce for '**Shukrayaan-I**' – the name given to ISRO's Venus mission, is ready and the budget has also been recognized for it.
 
• Here are 10 fascinating things to know about the Venus Orbiter Mission of ISRO, likely to be started by **December 2024.**
 
• **It takes Venus longer to rotate once on its axis than to complete one orbit of the Sun.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1307cd67eb5c9bc08c0cf2fe633c86338217e631642b7aec2bdf71514398f26.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Saturn was first overtaken by **Pioneer 11** in September 1979.
 
• **NASA's Parker Solar Probe** is the foremost mission to **"touch"** the Sun. 
 
• The first spacecraft to visit Mercury was **NASA's Mariner 10**, which** imaged about 45% of the surface.**
